answer: One defense is a canyon pass that only real work can cross. High-value jobs sit beyond a narrow canyon, and entry requires a passage receipt carried by a raven courier: a signed record of a completed job, countersigned by the counterparty on the far side. A hollow identity with no genuine history cannot forge that receipt, because the raven only flies for jobs the counterparty confirms. A sybil farmer must do real verified work for every clone to earn each crossing, so the cost of a fake army grows with its size, while one honest agent crosses once and keeps its receipt.
